stata_call: regtab, coef("OR") keep(treated) models("Crude \ Adjusted \ IPTW \ MSM")
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("cohort_pp"); d$period <- factor(d$period); f0 <- function(fm) glm(fm, family = binomial, data = d, control = glm.control(epsilon = 1e-12, maxit = 100)); f1 <- function(fm) suppressWarnings(glm(fm, family = binomial, data = d, weights = iptw, control = glm.control(epsilon = 1e-12, maxit = 100))); regtab(f0(ev ~ treated + period), f0(ev ~ treated + index_age + female + period), f1(ev ~ treated + period), f1(ev ~ treated + index_age + female + period), vce = "cluster", cluster = ~id, coef = "OR", keep = "treated", models = c("Crude", "Adjusted", "IPTW", "MSM"))

description: 5w: Per-model vce: crude and adjusted (oim), IPTW [pw] (robust), MSM on person-periods (cluster id)
stata_setup: quietly collect: logit cv_event treated ; quietly collect: logit cv_event treated index_age female ; quietly collect: logit cv_event treated [pw=iptw] ; use "fixtures/cohort_pp.dta", clear ; quietly collect: logit ev treated i.period [pw=iptw], vce(cluster id)

r_call: d <- golden_fixture("cohort"); p <- golden_fixture("cohort_pp"); p$period <- factor(p$period); ctl <- glm.control(epsilon = 1e-12, maxit = 100); regtab(glm(cv_event ~ treated, family = binomial, data = d, control = ctl), glm(cv_event ~ treated + index_age + female, family = binomial, data = d, control = ctl), glm(cv_event ~ treated, family = quasibinomial, data = d, weights = iptw, control = ctl), glm(ev ~ treated + period, family = quasibinomial, data = p, weights = iptw, control = ctl), vce = list("stata", "stata", "robust", "cluster"), cluster = list(NULL, NULL, NULL, ~id), keep = "treated", coef = "OR", models = c("Crude", "Adjusted", "IPTW", "MSM"), stats = "n")

description: 5w: Cox crude / adjusted / IPTW (per-model vce, cluster id)
stata_setup: gen double fu_y = follow_up/365.25 ; stset fu_y, failure(cv_event) id(id) ; quietly collect: stcox treated, breslow ; quietly collect: stcox treated index_age female, breslow ; stset fu_y [pw=iptw], failure(cv_event) id(id) ; quietly collect: stcox treated, breslow

description: 5w: glm [pw] vce(cluster id) (OR) vs geeglm independence, gee_as = glm

r_call: d <- golden_fixture("auto"); regtab(glm(foreign ~ mpg, family = binomial, data = d, control = glm.control(epsilon = 1e-14)), stats = c("n", "F", "rmse", "r2_a"))

description: C4/5.17: stats(events) on stcox and streg (e(N_fail))
stata_setup: stset follow_up, failure(cv_event) ; quietly collect: stcox treated index_age female ; quietly collect: streg treated index_age female, distribution(weibull) time
stata_call: regtab, stats(n events ll) models("Cox" \ "Weibull AFT")
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("cohort"); regtab(survival::coxph(survival::Surv(follow_up, cv_event) ~ treated + index_age + female, data = d, ties = "breslow"), survival::survreg(survival::Surv(follow_up, cv_event) ~ treated + index_age + female, data = d, dist = "weibull"), stats = c("n", "events", "ll"), models = c("Cox", "Weibull AFT"))

description: C4/5.17: regress F under vce(robust) and vce(cluster) (blank with fewer clusters than coefficients)
stata_setup: generate byte c3 = mod(_n, 3) ; quietly collect: regress price mpg weight, vce(robust) ; quietly collect: regress price mpg weight, vce(cluster c3) ; quietly collect: regress price mpg, vce(cluster c3)
stata_call: regtab, stats(n r2_a rmse F) models("Robust" \ "Cluster (3)" \ "Cluster (3), 1 slope")
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("auto"); d$c3 <- seq_len(nrow(d)) %% 3; regtab(lm(price ~ mpg + weight, data = d), lm(price ~ mpg + weight, data = d), lm(price ~ mpg, data = d), vce = list("robust", "cluster", "cluster"), cluster = list(NULL, ~c3, ~c3), stats = c("n", "r2_a", "rmse", "F"), models = c("Robust", "Cluster (3)", "Cluster (3), 1 slope"))

description: C4/5.17: svy: regress F (design-based adjusted Wald), no r2_a/rmse
stata_setup: generate double w = turn / 40 ; svyset _n [pw=w] ; quietly collect: svy: regress price mpg weight
stata_call: regtab, stats(n r2 r2_a rmse F)
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("auto"); d$w <- d$turn / 40; regtab(survey::svyglm(price ~ mpg + weight, design = survey::svydesign(ids = ~1, weights = ~w, data = d)), stats = c("n", "r2", "r2_a", "rmse", "F"))

description: C4 review F3: mi estimate, level(90): regress (90% intervals on each coefficient's t(df))
stata_setup: mi import flong, m(mi_m) id(id) imputed(index_age education) clear ; quietly collect: mi estimate, level(90): regress bmi treated index_age female i.education
stata_call: regtab, stats(n mi_m fmi) models("MI regress, 90%")
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("mi_cohort", factors = "education"); regtab(tt_mi(golden_mi_fits(d, function(x) lm(bmi ~ treated + index_age + female + education, data = x))), level = 90, stats = c("n", "mi_m", "fmi"), models = "MI regress, 90%")

description: C4 review O1: streg after stset [pw]: Subjects the weight sum, events weighted, BIC with e(N) records
stata_setup: keep in 1/2000 ; stset follow_up [pw=iptw], failure(cv_event) ; quietly collect: streg treated index_age, distribution(weibull) time
stata_call: regtab, stats(n events ll aic bic)
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("cohort"); regtab(survival::survreg(survival::Surv(follow_up, cv_event) ~ treated + index_age, data = d, subset = seq_len(nrow(d)) <= 2000, dist = "weibull", weights = iptw, robust = TRUE), stats = c("n", "events", "ll", "aic", "bic"))

description: 2.1.13 (X1): a Poisson covariate alpha and the nbreg ancillary alpha keep their own rows (keepintercept)
stata_setup: generate double alpha = x1 ; quietly collect: poisson y alpha mid high ; quietly collect: nbreg y mid high
stata_call: regtab, keepintercept models(Poisson \ NB)
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("nbsim"); d$alpha <- as.vector(d$x1); regtab(glm(y ~ alpha + mid + high, poisson, d), MASS::glm.nb(y ~ mid + high, data = d, control = glm.control(epsilon = 1e-14, maxit = 200)), keepintercept = TRUE, models = c("Poisson", "NB"))

description: 2.1.13 (X2): R68 with the nbreg model first
stata_setup: generate double alpha = x1 ; quietly collect: nbreg y mid high ; quietly collect: poisson y alpha mid high
stata_call: regtab, keepintercept models(NB \ Poisson)
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("nbsim"); d$alpha <- as.vector(d$x1); regtab(MASS::glm.nb(y ~ mid + high, data = d, control = glm.control(epsilon = 1e-14, maxit = 200)), glm(y ~ alpha + mid + high, poisson, d), keepintercept = TRUE, models = c("NB", "Poisson"))

description: 2.1.13 (X3): a regress covariate cut1 beside an ologit keeps its own row; the cutpoint cut1 stays next to cut2
stata_setup: generate double cut1 = income_quintile ; quietly collect: regress index_age cut1 female ; quietly collect: ologit education female
stata_call: regtab, keepintercept models(Linear \ Ordinal)
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("cohort", factors = "education"); d$cut1 <- as.vector(d$income_quintile); regtab(lm(index_age ~ cut1 + female, data = d), MASS::polr(education ~ female, data = d, Hess = TRUE, control = list(reltol = 1e-14, maxit = 1000)), keepintercept = TRUE, models = c("Linear", "Ordinal"))

description: 2.1.13 (X4): R68 without keepintercept drops the ancillary rows and keeps the covariate alpha
stata_setup: generate double alpha = x1 ; quietly collect: poisson y alpha mid high ; quietly collect: nbreg y mid high
stata_call: regtab, models(Poisson \ NB)
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("nbsim"); d$alpha <- as.vector(d$x1); regtab(glm(y ~ alpha + mid + high, poisson, d), MASS::glm.nb(y ~ mid + high, data = d, control = glm.control(epsilon = 1e-14, maxit = 200)), models = c("Poisson", "NB"))

description: 2.1.13 (X5): one Weibull AFT with covariates ln_p and p; the private ancillary rows follow the covariates (ln_p, p, 1/p)
stata_setup: generate double ln_p = index_age ; generate double p = income_quintile ; stset follow_up, failure(cv_event) ; quietly collect: streg treated ln_p p female, distribution(weibull) time
stata_call: regtab, keepintercept
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("cohort"); d$ln_p <- as.vector(d$index_age); d$p <- as.vector(d$income_quintile); regtab(survival::survreg(survival::Surv(follow_up, cv_event) ~ treated + ln_p + p + female, data = d, dist = "weibull"), keepintercept = TRUE)

description: 2.1.13 (X6): a regress with covariates ln_p and p beside a Weibull AFT; covariate rows first, then the ancillary block
stata_setup: generate double ln_p = index_age ; generate double p = income_quintile ; quietly collect: regress follow_up ln_p p female ; stset follow_up, failure(cv_event) ; quietly collect: streg ln_p p female, distribution(weibull) time
stata_call: regtab, keepintercept models(Linear \ Weibull)
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("cohort"); d$ln_p <- as.vector(d$index_age); d$p <- as.vector(d$income_quintile); regtab(lm(follow_up ~ ln_p + p + female, data = d), survival::survreg(survival::Surv(follow_up, cv_event) ~ ln_p + p + female, data = d, dist = "weibull"), keepintercept = TRUE, models = c("Linear", "Weibull"))

description: 5.15: clogit, or on 1:1-1:3 matched sets (OR header by classification since tabtools 2.1.14)
stata_setup: quietly collect: clogit case x1 smoke i.grp, group(set) or
stata_call: regtab, stats(n ll aic)
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("clogit", factors = "grp"); regtab(local({coxph <- survival::coxph; Surv <- survival::Surv; survival::clogit(case ~ x1 + smoke + grp + survival::strata(set), data = d)}), stats = c("n", "ll", "aic"))

description: 5.15: clogit, or on the 1:1 matched pairs (if matched11)
stata_setup: quietly collect: clogit case x1 smoke i.grp if matched11, group(set) or
stata_call: regtab, stats(n)
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("clogit", factors = "grp"); regtab(local({coxph <- survival::coxph; Surv <- survival::Surv; survival::clogit(case ~ x1 + smoke + grp + survival::strata(set), data = d, subset = matched11 == 1)}), stats = "n")

description: 5.15: logistic beside clogit, or: the logistic loses its intercept (2.1.14); stats(groups) adds no row (clogit stores no e(N_group))
stata_setup: quietly collect: logistic case x1 smoke i.grp ; quietly collect: clogit case x1 smoke i.grp, group(set) or
stata_call: regtab, stats(n groups) models(Unconditional \ Conditional)
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("clogit", factors = "grp"); regtab(glm(case ~ x1 + smoke + grp, binomial, d, control = glm.control(epsilon = 1e-14)), local({coxph <- survival::coxph; Surv <- survival::Surv; survival::clogit(case ~ x1 + smoke + grp + survival::strata(set), data = d)}), stats = c("n", "groups"), models = c("Unconditional", "Conditional"))

description: 7.13: univariable logistic models, one per covariate (a Stata foreach loop of collect: logistic y x); regtab_uv() stacks them
stata_setup: quietly collect: logistic cv_event index_age ; quietly collect: logistic cv_event female ; quietly collect: logistic cv_event i.education
stata_call: regtab, coef("OR") noint stats(n) models(Age \ Female \ Education)
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("cohort", factors = "education"); regtab(glm(cv_event ~ index_age, binomial, d, control = glm.control(epsilon = 1e-14)), glm(cv_event ~ female, binomial, d, control = glm.control(epsilon = 1e-14)), glm(cv_event ~ education, binomial, d, control = glm.control(epsilon = 1e-14)), coef = "OR", nointercept = TRUE, stats = "n", models = c("Age", "Female", "Education"))

description: 5.19: nlme::lme ML random intercept as mixed (R21's model), relabel stats(n groups ll aic bic icc)
stata_setup: quietly collect: mixed y age female bmi || region:
stata_call: regtab, coef("Coef.") stats(n groups ll aic bic icc) relabel models("Mixed")
r_call: regtab(nlme::lme(y ~ age + female + bmi, random = ~ 1 | region, data = golden_fixture("mixed_bp"), method = "ML"), coef = "Coef.", stats = c("n", "groups", "ll", "aic", "bic", "icc"), relabel = TRUE, models = "Mixed")

description: 5.19: nlme::lme REML as mixed, reml, relabel stats(n groups ll aic icc)
stata_setup: quietly collect: mixed y age female bmi || region:, reml
stata_call: regtab, coef("Coef.") stats(n groups ll aic icc) relabel models("REML")
r_call: regtab(nlme::lme(y ~ age + female + bmi, random = ~ 1 | region, data = golden_fixture("mixed_bp"), method = "REML"), coef = "Coef.", stats = c("n", "groups", "ll", "aic", "icc"), models = "REML", relabel = TRUE)

description: 5.19: nlme::lme unstructured random slope (pdLogChol) as mixed, cov(unstructured), raw names
stata_setup: quietly collect: mixed y age female bmi || region: age, cov(unstructured)
stata_call: regtab, coef("Coef.") stats(n groups icc)
r_call: regtab(nlme::lme(y ~ age + female + bmi, random = ~ age | region, data = golden_fixture("mixed_bp"), method = "ML", control = nlme::lmeControl(niterEM = 200, msMaxIter = 1000)), coef = "Coef.", stats = c("n", "groups", "icc"))

description: 5.19: nlme::lme independent random slope (pdDiag) as mixed's default cov(independent), relabel
stata_setup: quietly collect: mixed bmi age i.sex || location: age
stata_call: regtab, coef("Coef.") stats(n groups icc) relabel models("Independent")
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("nhanes2", factors = "sex"); regtab(nlme::lme(bmi ~ age + sex, random = list(location = nlme::pdDiag(~ age)), data = d, method = "ML"), coef = "Coef.", stats = c("n", "groups", "icc"), relabel = TRUE, models = "Independent")

description: 5.19: nlme::lme three-level nested (~ 1 | zone/location) as mixed || zone: || location:, relabel
stata_setup: generate byte zone = ceil(location / 10) ; label variable zone "Zone" ; quietly collect: mixed bmi age i.sex || zone: || location:
stata_call: regtab, coef("Coef.") stats(n groups icc) relabel models("Three-level")
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("nhanes2", factors = "sex"); d$zone <- ceiling(d$location / 10); attr(d$zone, "label") <- "Zone"; regtab(nlme::lme(bmi ~ age + sex, random = ~ 1 | zone/location, data = d, method = "ML"), coef = "Coef.", stats = c("n", "groups", "icc"), relabel = TRUE, models = "Three-level")

stata_setup: quietly collect: clogit case x1 smoke i.grp, group(set)
stata_call: regtab, stats(n ll aic)
r_call: d <- golden_fixture("clogit", factors = "grp"); regtab(local({coxph <- survival::coxph; Surv <- survival::Surv; survival::clogit(case ~ x1 + smoke + grp + survival::strata(set), data = d)}), stats = c("n", "ll", "aic"))
